title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium - Duke University on 1973-12-08
source: Stereo Soundboard  > Master Reel  > ? > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a mellow, beautiful 1973 performance—missing the opening track but otherwise crisp and enjoyable.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this recording for its warm, airy sound and excellent vocals that highlight the Dead’s more relaxed side in late‑1973. The only technical blemish noted is the absence of the first song, yet the rest of the set flows beautifully and showcases a great show overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Two high‑star reviews (4 & 5) indicate strong musical performance; minor recording issue (missing opening track) keeps the rating just below top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced sound, with vocals highlighted; first song of the set is missing from this file.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mellow, airy playing creates a smooth flow; reviewers describe the performance as beautiful and relaxed.
